name: has_color
title: Does the current R session support ANSI colors?

origin.description: TRUE when the session will emit ANSI color.
origin.details: This is num_ansi_colors() > 1. crayon.enabled TRUE forces that count to 8 unless crayon.colors or cli.num_colors says otherwise.

translation.description: TRUE when the session will emit ANSI color.
translation.details: True when num_ansi_colors() is greater than 1. A non-interactive process with no option set reports False, matching Rscript.
